tours.title: City & Uphill Tour
tours.shortDescription: Explore Cebu City's historical landmarks and scenic highland viewpoints in this comprehensive 8-hour tour.
tours.description: Experience the best of Cebu City with our City & Uphill Tour. Visit iconic landmarks including the Temple of Leah, Sirao Flower Garden, and Tops Busay for panoramic views. Explore historical sites like Fort San Pedro, Sto. Nino Church, and Magellan's Cross. This tour combines cultural heritage with natural beauty for an unforgettable Cebu experience.

itinerary.activity: Pickup at Airport or Hotel Cebu City
Dropoff at Airport or Hotels Cebu City

exclusions: La Vie Entrance Fee of P100 (Consumable)

tours.title: Cebu Safari Adventure
tours.shortDescription: Discover exotic wildlife at Cebu's premier safari and adventure park in Carmen.
tours.description: Journey to Carmen, Cebu for an unforgettable wildlife experience at Cebu Safari Adventure Park. Get up close with exotic animals from around the world, enjoy scenic views of the Cebu highlands, and experience adventure activities. The park features diverse wildlife exhibits, bird sanctuaries, and family-friendly attractions.

tours.title: Moalboal & Canyoneering
tours.shortDescription: Swim with sardines, watch sea turtles, and conquer thrilling canyoneering at Kawasan Falls.
tours.description: Experience the ultimate Cebu adventure combining the marine wonders of Moalboal with the thrills of Kawasan Falls canyoneering. Swim with millions of sardines in their natural habitat, spot sea turtles at the coral garden, and challenge yourself with cliff jumps and waterfall rappelling. This action-packed tour is perfect for adventure seekers!

itinerary.activity: Sunrise View at Barili (Stop over for Breakfast)
Drop off Cebu City or Airport

exclusions: Full Course Canyoneering with lunch is optional for P2,100/pax
Kawasan Falls entrance and guide fee is P500/pax
